documents.title: LangGraph overview (fixture)
documents.content: LangGraph is a library for building stateful, multi-step agent applications as graphs. It supports persistence through checkpointers, which let a run pause and resume. LangGraph supports human-in-the-loop interrupts and streaming of intermediate state. It is released under the MIT license.

documents.content: CrewAI is a framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous agents. Developers define agents with roles, goals and tools, and group them into crews that execute tasks sequentially or hierarchically. CrewAI is released under the MIT license.

documents.title: LangGraph vs CrewAI: a qualitative look (fixture)
documents.content: We compared LangGraph and CrewAI by building the same support-bot workflow in both. LangGraph gives explicit control over state transitions, while CrewAI offers a higher-level abstraction with roles. We did not run any latency or throughput benchmarks; our comparison is based on developer experience only.

documents.title: Notes on early LangGraph (fixture)
documents.content: In this early release LangGraph has no persistence: graph state lives only in memory and is lost when the process ends.
